files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: From riders.csv, for each rider with a joined_on date, find the weekday they joined (full English name, such as Monday) and the number of days from joined_on to 2025-11-01. `result` should be a table with columns rider_id (text, leading zeros kept), joined_weekday and days_member, riders without a date left out, in file order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv keeping rider_id as text; for riders with a joined_on date: joined_weekday = English weekday name of joined_on, days_member = calendar days from joined_on to 2025-11-01. Columns rider_id, joined_weekday, days_member; riders without a date left out; file order.
notes: Intent written in a separate step that did not use the catalogue or the pre-registration (Amendment 8 item 3; INTENTS_FRESH.tsv sha256 ffae987c...e666).
